passages.text: This is the account of Esau (that is, Edom).
passages.sermon: Esau was also called Edom.\r\nThis is the account of Esau.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite, and Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the son of Isaac.
Esau took wives from the daughters of Canaan.
He married Adah.
Adah was the daughter of Elon the Hittite.
He married Oholibamah.
Oholibamah was the daughter of Anah.
Anah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite.
He married Basemath.
Basemath was the daughter of Ishmael.
Basemath was the sister of Nebaioth.
passages.original: עֵשָׂ֛ו לָקַ֥ח אֶת־ נָשָׁ֖יו מִבְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן אֶת־ עָדָ֗ה בַּת־ אֵילוֹן֙ הַֽחִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־ אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ בַּת־ עֲנָ֔ה בַּת־ צִבְע֖וֹן הַֽחִוִּֽי׃ וְאֶת־ בָּשְׂמַ֥ת בַּת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֖אל אֲח֥וֹת נְבָיֽוֹת׃

passages.text: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath gave birth to Reuel, and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
passages.sermon:
Esau was also called Edom.
Adah was one of Esau’s wives.
Adah gave birth to Eliphaz.
Basemath was another wife of Esau.
Basemath gave birth to Reuel.
Oholibamah was also a wife of Esau.
Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush.
Oholibamah gave birth to Jalam.
Oholibamah gave birth to Korah.
These were the sons of Esau.
They were born to Esau in the land of Canaan.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֧לֶד עָדָ֛ה לְעֵשָׂ֖ו אֶת־ אֱלִיפָ֑ז וּבָ֣שְׂמַ֔ת יָלְדָ֖ה אֶת־ רְעוּאֵֽל׃ וְאָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ יָֽלְדָ֔ה אֶת־ יְעִישׁ וְאֶת־ יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־ קֹ֑רַח אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻלְּדוּ־ ל֖וֹ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: Later, Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the people of his household, along with his livestock, all his other animals, and all the property he had acquired in Canaan, and he moved to a land far away from his brother Jacob.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the brother of Jacob.
Esau lived in the land of Canaan.
Esau took his wives.
He took his sons.
He took his daughters.
He took all the people in his household.
He took his livestock.
He took all his other animals.
He took all the property he had gained in Canaan.
Esau moved to another land.
He moved away from his brother Jacob.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח עֵשָׂ֡ו אֶת־ נָ֠שָׁיו וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו וְאֶת־ בְּנֹתָיו֮ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ נַפְשׁ֣וֹת בֵּיתוֹ֒ וְאֶת־ מִקְנֵ֣הוּ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתּ֗וֹ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ קִנְיָנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָכַ֖שׁ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אֶל־ אֶ֔רֶץ מִפְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֥ב אָחִֽיו׃

passages.text: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together; the land where they stayed could not support them because of their livestock.
passages.sermon:
Esau and Jacob were brothers.
They both lived in the land of Canaan.
They each had many possessions.
Their possessions were very great.
They both had much livestock.
The land where they lived could not support both of them together.
The land could not provide enough for all their livestock.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָיָ֧ה רְכוּשָׁ֛ם רָ֖ב מִשֶּׁ֣בֶת יַחְדָּ֑ו וְלֹ֨א יָֽכְלָ֜ה אֶ֤רֶץ מְגֽוּרֵיהֶם֙ לָשֵׂ֣את אֹתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י מִקְנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir.
passages.sermon: Esau is also called Edom.\r\nEsau settled in the area of Mount Seir.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב עֵשָׂו֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר עֵשָׂ֖ו ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: This is the account of Esau, the father of the Edomites, in the area of Mount Seir.
passages.sermon: Esau was the father of the Edomites.\r\nHe lived in the area of Mount Seir.\r\nThis is the account of Esau.
passages.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תֹּלְד֥וֹת עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֣י אֱד֑וֹם בְּהַ֖ר שֵׂעִֽיר׃

passages.text: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the father of the Edomites.
He lived in the area of Mount Seir.
Esau had sons.
These are the names of Esau’s sons.
Eliphaz was the son of Adah.
Adah was Esau’s wife.
Reuel was the son of Basemath.
Basemath was Esau’s wife.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֗ז בֶּן־ עָדָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו רְעוּאֵ֕ל בֶּן־ בָּשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
passages.sermon: Eliphaz was a son of Esau.\r\nEliphaz had five sons.\r\nTheir names were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֣ן אוֹמָ֔ר צְפ֥וֹ וְגַעְתָּ֖ם וּקְנַֽז׃

passages.text: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek. These are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
passages.sermon:
Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz.
Eliphaz was the son of Esau.
Timna gave birth to Amalek for Eliphaz.
Amalek was a grandson of Adah.
Adah was Esau’s wife.
passages.original: וְתִמְנַ֣ע׀ הָיְתָ֣ה פִילֶ֗גֶשׁ לֶֽאֱלִיפַז֙ בֶּן־ עֵשָׂ֔ו וַתֵּ֥לֶד לֶאֱלִיפַ֖ז אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
passages.sermon:
Reuel was a son of Esau.
Reuel had four sons.
Their names were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Basemath was Esau’s wife.
Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah were Basemath’s grandsons.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְעוּאֵ֔ל נַ֥חַת וָזֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֣ה וּמִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּ֣ה הָי֔וּ בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah (daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon) whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
passages.sermon:
Oholibamah was Esau’s wife.
Oholibamah was the daughter of Anah.
Anah was the child of Zibeon.
Oholibamah gave birth to three sons for Esau.
Their names were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הָי֗וּ בְּנֵ֨י אָהֳלִיבָמָ֧ה בַת־ עֲנָ֛ה בַּת־ צִבְע֖וֹן אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֑ו וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעֵשָׂ֔ו אֶת־ יְעִישׁ וְאֶת־ יַעְלָ֖ם וְאֶת־ קֹֽרַח׃

passages.text: These are the chiefs among the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. They are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Adah.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the father of many sons.
Eliphaz was the firstborn son of Esau.
Eliphaz had several sons.
These sons became chiefs.
Their names were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, Korah, Gatam, and Amalek.
These men were chiefs in the land of Edom.
They were the sons of Eliphaz.
They were grandsons of Adah.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־ עֵשָׂ֑ו בְּנֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּכ֣וֹר עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֤וּף תֵּימָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף אוֹמָ֔ר אַלּ֥וּף צְפ֖וֹ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַֽז׃ אַלּֽוּף־ קֹ֛רַח אַלּ֥וּף גַּעְתָּ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף עֲמָלֵ֑ק אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י אֱלִיפַז֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י עָדָֽה׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. They are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom, and they are the grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
passages.sermon:
Reuel was the son of Esau.
Reuel had four sons.
Their names were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
Each son became a chief.
These chiefs came from Reuel.
They lived in the land of Edom.
Reuel’s mother was Basemath.
Basemath was Esau’s wife.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בֶּן־ עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף נַ֙חַת֙ אַלּ֣וּף זֶ֔רַח אַלּ֥וּף שַׁמָּ֖ה אַלּ֣וּף מִזָּ֑ה אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֤י רְעוּאֵל֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם אֵ֕לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י בָשְׂמַ֖ת אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. They are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
passages.sermon:
Oholibamah was Esau’s wife.
Oholibamah was the daughter of Anah.
Oholibamah had sons named Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
Jeush became a chief.
Jalam became a chief.
Korah became a chief.
These men were chiefs descended from Oholibamah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵ֤י אָהֳלִֽיבָמָה֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת עֵשָׂ֔ו אַלּ֥וּף יְע֛וּשׁ אַלּ֥וּף יַעְלָ֖ם אַלּ֣וּף קֹ֑רַח אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֞י אָֽהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה בַּת־ עֲנָ֖ה אֵ֥שֶׁת עֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: All these are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and they were their chiefs.
passages.sermon:
Esau is also called Edom.
Esau had sons.
These men were the sons of Esau.
These men were also chiefs.
passages.original: אֵ֧לֶּה בְנֵי־ עֵשָׂ֛ו וְאֵ֥לֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא אֱדֽוֹם׃ס

passages.text: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, the descendants of Seir in the land of Edom.
passages.sermon:
Seir was a Horite.
Seir lived in the land of Edom.
Seir had sons.
The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
These men were chiefs among the Horites.
The Horites were the descendants of Seir.
The Horites lived in the land of Edom.
passages.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ שֵׂעִיר֙ הַחֹרִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָ֑רֶץ לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֥וֹן וַעֲנָֽה׃ וְדִשׁ֥וֹן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י שֵׂעִ֖יר בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
passages.sermon:
Lotan was a son of Seir the Horite.
Lotan lived in the land of Edom.
Lotan had two sons.
Their names were Hori and Hemam.
Lotan had a sister.
Her name was Timna.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי־ לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהֵימָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
passages.sermon:
Shobal was a chief of the Horites.
Shobal was a descendant of Seir.
Shobal lived in the land of Edom.
Shobal had sons.
His sons were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְוָ֥ן וּמָנַ֖חַת וְעֵיבָ֑ל שְׁפ֖וֹ וְאוֹנָֽם׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness as he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.)
passages.sermon:
Zibeon had two sons.
Their names were Aiah and Anah.
Anah was the son who found the hot springs in the wilderness.
Anah found the hot springs while he was taking care of his father Zibeon's donkeys.
passages.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ צִבְע֖וֹן וְאַיָּ֣ה וַעֲנָ֑ה ה֣וּא עֲנָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א אֶת־ הַיֵּמִם֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר בִּרְעֹת֥וֹ אֶת־ הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים לְצִבְע֥וֹן אָבִֽיו׃

passages.text: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
passages.sermon:
Anah had two children.
One child was Dishon.
The other child was Oholibamah.
Oholibamah was a daughter of Anah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ עֲנָ֖ה דִּשֹׁ֑ן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָ֖ה בַּת־ עֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
passages.sermon: Dishon was a chief of the Horites in the land of Seir.\r\nDishon had four sons.\r\nTheir names were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
passages.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י דִישָׁ֑ן חֶמְדָּ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
passages.sermon: Ezer had sons.\r\nEzer’s sons were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵי־ אֵ֑צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן וַעֲקָֽן׃

passages.text: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
passages.sermon: Dishan had sons.\r\nTheir names were Uz and Aran.
passages.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־ דִישָׁ֖ן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃

passages.text: These are the chiefs of the Horites: Chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. They are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their divisions in the land of Seir.
passages.sermon:
The Horites lived in the land of Seir.
They had chiefs who led them.
The chiefs of the Horites were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
Each chief led his own group.
These men were the chiefs of the Horites in their land.
passages.original: אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֣י הַחֹרִ֑י אַלּ֤וּף לוֹטָן֙ אַלּ֣וּף שׁוֹבָ֔ל אַלּ֥וּף צִבְע֖וֹן אַלּ֥וּף עֲנָֽה׃ אַלּ֥וּף דִּשֹׁ֛ן אַלּ֥וּף אֵ֖צֶר אַלּ֣וּף דִּישָׁ֑ן אֵ֣לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֧י הַחֹרִ֛י לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ שֵׂעִֽיר׃פ

passages.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom; the name of his city was Dinhabah.
passages.sermon:
These are the kings of Edom.
They ruled before any king ruled over the Israelites.
Bela was the son of Beor.
Bela ruled in Edom.
The name of Bela’s city was Dinhabah.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הַמְּלָכִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלְכ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ בֶּאֱד֔וֹם בֶּ֖לַע בֶּן־ בְּע֑וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃

passages.text: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Bela was a king in Edom.
Bela died.
Jobab became king after Bela.
Jobab was the son of Zerah.
Jobab was from Bozrah.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־ זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃

passages.text: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Jobab was a king in Edom.
Jobab died.
Husham became king after Jobab.
Husham came from the land of the Temanites.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חֻשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃

passages.text: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
passages.sermon:
Husham died.
Hadad became king after Husham.
Hadad was the son of Bedad.
Hadad defeated Midian in the country of Moab.
Hadad’s city was named Avith.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חֻשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ עֲוִֽית׃

passages.text: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
passages.sermon: Hadad died.\r\nSamlah became king after him.\r\nSamlah came from Masrekah.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃

passages.text: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Samlah was a king of Edom.
Samlah died.
Shaul became king after Samlah.
Shaul came from Rehoboth on the Euphrates.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃

passages.text: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
passages.sermon:
Shaul was a king.
Shaul died.
Baal-hanan became king after Shaul.
Baal-hanan was the son of Achbor.
passages.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּֽוֹר׃

passages.text: When Baal-hanan son of Achbor died, Hadad reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
passages.sermon:
Baal-hanan was the son of Achbor.
Baal-hanan died.
Hadad became king after Baal-hanan.
Hadad’s city was called Pau.
Hadad’s wife was named Mehetabel.
Mehetabel was the daughter of Matred.
Matred was the daughter of Me-zahab.
passages.original: וַיָּמָת֮ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֣ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּוֹר֒ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עוּ וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵֽיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־ מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: These are the names of Esau’s chiefs, according to their families and regions, by their names: Chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they possessed. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the father of the Edomites.
Esau had chiefs who led his people.
These chiefs belonged to different families.
Each chief lived in a certain region.
Their names were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth, Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon, Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, Magdiel, and Iram.
These men were the chiefs of Edom.
They lived in the land that belonged to them.
Each chief ruled in his own settlement.
passages.original: וְ֠אֵלֶּה שְׁמ֞וֹת אַלּוּפֵ֤י עֵשָׂו֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם לִמְקֹמֹתָ֖ם בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַֽלְוָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃ אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃ אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֥וּף מִבְצָֽר׃ אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֣לֶּה׀ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֗וֹם לְמֹֽשְׁבֹתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם ה֥וּא עֵשָׂ֖ו אֲבִ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ
